title: New ways to make music and work with audio
summary:
New music, image, and audio models joined a more perceptive CatGPT, while API key reads got less forgetful.

ACE-Step 1.5 Turbo was added as an alpha music model: send lyrics to the audio endpoint and get an MP3, with optional duration and style controls. `openai-audio` was updated to a newer mini model, and a paid-only `openai-audio-large` option was added.

Wan 2.7 Image and Image Pro were added for generation and editing, with up to nine input images for edits; Pro also supports 4K text-to-image requests. The `ltx-2` registry now identifies LTX-2.3 and accepts `ltx-2.3` as an alias, alongside backend work on its two-stage upscaler.

CatGPT now writes a short reply before generating its webcomic and includes that reply in the image prompt. Its web app and Discord bot can also use an attached image to inform the reply. Existing web-app users will need to authorize it again.

daily.title: Lyrics into music
daily.text: Use the alpha `acestep` model to turn lyrics into an MP3, with optional `duration` and `style` controls. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=acestep).

daily.title: Wan 2.7 images
daily.text: Generate or edit images with `wan-image` and `wan-image-pro`. Edits accept up to nine input images; Pro supports 4K text-to-image requests. [Browse the models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=wan-image).

daily.title: New OpenAI audio options
daily.text: `openai-audio` now uses a newer mini model, and paid-only `openai-audio-large` offers a larger option. [Browse the audio models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=openai-audio).

daily.title: LTX-2.3 video update
daily.text: The `ltx-2` video model is now identified as LTX-2.3 and also accepts `ltx-2.3` as an alias. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=ltx-2).

daily.title: CatGPT gets visual context
daily.text: CatGPT now writes its cat reply before making the webcomic, and its web app and Discord bot can respond to an attached image. Existing web-app users will need to authorize it again.
